test_cases.title: Direct Single-Message Lead
test_cases.scenario: good morning my name is vivek and my mobile number is 630 7089085 can u provide me a call back for website development
test_cases.expected_behavior: Instantly parses Name (Vivek), Phone (6307089085), and Purpose. Saves to Leadcore DB and confirms callback without re-asking questions.

test_cases.title: Step-by-Step Interactive Flow
test_cases.scenario: Step 1: "I need a call back" -> Step 2: "Rahul" -> Step 3: "9494259453" -> Step 4: "skip" -> Step 5: "Next.js Web App"
test_cases.expected_behavior: Prompts Name -> Phone -> Email -> Purpose. Handles 'skip' for Email, saves record to Leadcore DB on final step.

test_cases.title: Pricing Query
test_cases.scenario: What are your pricing plans?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Lists ₹18,000 Tech, ₹26,400 Marketing, and Custom Ecosystem options without bold ** markers. Ends with: "Can I arrange a call back from our team?".

test_cases.title: Portfolio Case Studies
test_cases.scenario: Show me your portfolio case studies
test_cases.expected_behavior: Displays TripSpark (+200% conversion), Appointment Automation, AI Property Assistant, Analytics Dashboard, and Property Listing portal.

test_cases.title: Services Overview
test_cases.scenario: What services do you offer?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Lists all 6 core services (Web Dev, App Dev, AI Automation, Social Media, Digital Ads, Branding).

test_cases.title: Explicit Email Skipping
test_cases.scenario: Entering "skip" or "no email" during Email step
test_cases.expected_behavior: Accepts skip, bypasses email validation, and moves smoothly to Purpose step or final lead saving.

test_cases.title: Mid-Flow Question Pivot
test_cases.scenario: While asked for Phone: "Actually how much does a landing page cost first?"
test_cases.expected_behavior: Answers pricing question without losing context, then politely resumes: "Would you like to continue scheduling your callback now?".

test_cases.title: Partial Lead Info Extraction
test_cases.scenario: Hi I'm Sarah, call me at 9876543210 for a Flutter mobile app
test_cases.expected_behavior: Extracts Name (Sarah), Phone (9876543210), and Purpose (Flutter mobile app). Bypasses already-known questions.

test_cases.title: Short Phone Validation
test_cases.scenario: Entering "98765" during Phone step
test_cases.expected_behavior: Rejects short input (<10 digits) and prompts: "That looks a bit short for a phone number. Could you please share a valid 10-digit number?".

test_cases.title: Time Slot Extraction
test_cases.scenario: Call me tomorrow strictly between 2 PM and 4 PM at 9494259453
test_cases.expected_behavior: Extracts preferred time slot (tomorrow strictly between 2 PM and 4 PM) and stores it in lead_notes in Leadcore DB.

test_cases.title: Out-of-Scope Guardrails
test_cases.scenario: Can you fix my local printer hardware or write crypto smart contracts?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Politely declines hardware/crypto, re-anchors to web/apps/AI automations, and offers a discovery call.

interruption_and_recovery_rules.scenario: User asks for company pricing mid-way through callback collection
interruption_and_recovery_rules.behavior:
1. Pause active callback state machine.
2. Answer pricing query directly (₹18,000 Tech / ₹26,400 Marketing).
3. Append transition prompt: 'Would you like to continue scheduling your callback now?'
4. Resume callback state at the exact pending step if user says yes.

interruption_and_recovery_rules.scenario: User asks for company phone number during the Name step
interruption_and_recovery_rules.behavior:
1. Do NOT save interrogative sentence as user's name.
2. Output click-to-call link [📞 Call +91 9494259453](tel:+919494259453) and WhatsApp link.
3. Re-prompt politely: 'May I have your name so our team knows who to ask for when reaching out?'

interruption_and_recovery_rules.scenario: User sends greeting ('hi', 'hello') during the Phone step
interruption_and_recovery_rules.behavior:
1. Respond to greeting naturally ('Hello!').
2. Re-prompt for phone number: 'To schedule your callback, could you please share your 10-digit mobile number?'
3. Do NOT flag greeting string as an invalid short phone number.

interruption_and_recovery_rules.scenario: User requests direct calendar booking instead of a callback
interruption_and_recovery_rules.behavior:
1. Cancel active callback collection flow.
2. Output direct booking link: [📅 Book Strategy Meeting](https://cal.com/webb-heads).
3. Confirm session is open for any other inquiries.
